# Changelog

All notable changes to **Gnome Lean Dock 1** will be documented in this file.

The format is based on [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.0.0/),
and this project adheres to [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html).

> **Note on versioning**: GNOME Shell requires strictly integer version numbers (`1`, `2`, `3`...) in `metadata.json`. The correspondence is indicated under each release section below.

---

## [1.0.0] - 2026-09-08

> **GNOME Shell Extension version**: 1

### Added
- **Streamlined dock** for GNOME Shell 49 and 50.
- **Intellihide and autohide** support.
- **Window previews** and running indicators.
- **Configurable dock position**: Top, Bottom, Left, Right.
- **Libadwaita preferences** window.
